description: Sweep optimization recipes (preset × meshopt × decimate × KTX2 quality) for the input asset and return the winning recipe under the configured policy. Uses cohort-aware pruning + grid warm-start + TPE Bayesian search (SPEC-0044). The visual-quality gate is OFF by default — pass `with_quality_gate: true` to enable Playwright + ΔE94 / SSIM gating (much slower, ~30s per candidate).

output_path.description: Where to write the winning recipe GLB.

name: recipe_search
title: Auto-tune optimization recipes via TPE Bayesian search
